lines.en: Little red apple, round and sweet,
Hanging on the tree so neat.
I will pick you, one two three,
Yummy apple, just for me!
Hop, hop, little bunny,
Hop around so funny.
Wiggle your nose, twitch your ear,
Spring is finally here!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Pretty colors just for you.
Orange, purple, pink so bright,
Rainbow dancing in the light!
One, two, three, four, five,
Little fish are all alive.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten,
Count them all and start again!
This is Daddy, big and strong,
Mommy sings a happy song.
Sister laughs and brother plays,
Love is here on sunny days!
Pitter-patter, rain comes down,
Washing clean the sleepy town.
Hold your umbrella, don't be late,
Rainbow's waiting at the gate!
Clap your hands, one two three,
Stomp your feet along with me.
Nod your head and blink your eyes,
Now we reach up to the skies!
Good morning, sun, so warm and bright,
Thank you for your golden light.
Birds are singing in the tree,
A brand-new day for you and me!
Sleepy moon is in the sky,
Stars are winking way up high.
Close your eyes, my little dear,
Sweet dreams, good night is here!
Wash, wash, wash your little hands,
Rub-a-dub, the soap expands.
Rinse them clean from left to right,
Hands so clean and feeling light!
